# Required continuous-section boundary paragraphs

These 39 controls are original OPC/XML packages generated by
`python tools/continuous_boundary_fixture.py`, independently of the viewer's
DOCX writer. The sources, generator and reference data use the repository
license. No corpus markup or artwork was copied. The PDFs are native
reference output from these original controls.

Export each NAME.docx with `tools/export-reference.ps1` to NAME.pdf, then
run `python tools/continuous_boundary_reference.py` (requires pypdf).
`native.json` binds source/PDF SHA-256 hashes to page counts and all visible
text origins. Browser tests compare every origin within 0.15 pt.

The controls cover text/table boundaries, 12/24 pt exact lines, one/two-column
transitions, next-page transitions, sole empty sections, spacing, shading and
borders, 2/4/10 table rows, and compatibility modes 12/14/15. In mode 15 the reference application keeps
the required empty paragraph after a table before a continuous section on the
same paper; modes 12/14 suppress it. Sole empty continuous sections keep their
line in the tested modes 12/15. Retained boundaries keep spacing and shading,
suppress borders, and follow the final table row after columns are balanced.
The larger boundary height does not redistribute preceding table rows.

Unit/browser checks cover source immutability, caret positions, text insertion,
untouched package parts, exact undo and reopening. ECMA-376 Part 1 sections
17.6.18 and 17.6.22 define section storage/transitions; these layout distinctions
are measured reference behavior, not a full standards conformance claim.
